resources.string: Where you are on the climb, time and distance to the top, time to your Strava PR
Picks the number above the climb graph on one tile.
Picks the number above the climb graph on two tiles. Both: time to top big, your time vs PR under it.
Picks the lines above the climb graph on half a screen. The TO TOP bar and the graph always show.
Next to the climb icon wherever your PR shows.

Your bike with bottles and bags, for the time to top. Your own weight comes from your Karoo rider profile. Per ride profile: each profile you ride shows up here; one left empty uses the one-for-all weight (grey).
No ride profiles yet: pick one on the Karoo\'s home screen and it shows up here.
Oh nice, a weight weenie build!
Adds head- and tailwind on each part of the climb, from the Open-Meteo forecast. No connection: no wind.
Learns from each climb you ride (your speed against your power, the gradient and the wind), so the time to top gets better with every climb.
The data stays on your Karoo and never leaves it.
Your PR comes from the Karoo\'s own Strava Live Segments (Karoo Settings › Strava). Climbs come from the route you load.
